items.title: Multi-page browse: follow pagination / 'next' / 'load more' to gather N results across pages
items.why: anvil browse/scrape reads ONE page only (grep pagination|load more|next page = 0 in agent.ts + anvil.ts). A 'find the 5 cheapest flights' / 'newest 20 listings' errand only ever sees page-one results — the exact multi-page loop the competitor (Instinct) sells. A texting user asking for 'the 10 cheapest' silently gets whatever fit on one screen.
items.how: Add a bounded page-follow to the browse/find path: after reading a page, detect a next/pagination control (rel=next, a 'Next'/'More'/numbered pager, or an anchor whose text matches /next|more|older/), click it, accumulate results, cap at ~3-5 pages + a hard time budget. Reuse src/anvil.ts click+read. New tool arg or a 'depth'/'pages' hint. Offline unit test with a mock 2-page site + a LIVE e2e against a real paginated listing (e.g. HN news?p=2). Report items-gathered > page-one count.

items.title: Full-page screenshot (not just the viewport fold)
items.why: anvil.ts:463 captures the VIEWPORT only — 'screenshot the whole page' / 'screenshot this article' gives just the top fold, surprising a user who expected the full page.
items.how: Add a fullPage option to the screenshot capture in src/anvil.ts (CDP captureBeyondViewport / Page.captureScreenshot with fromSurface+full metrics, or puppeteer fullPage:true). Route 'whole/full/entire page' phrasing to it in the agent's screenshot dispatch; keep viewport as the default (smaller, faster). Live e2e: assert full-page bytes are materially larger than viewport for a long page.

items.title: Surface stoppedEarly on the non-/run chain paths (digest members, index.ts:174/211/970)
items.why: The interactive /run path (handler.ts:1737) flags a partial chain, but the digest-member + other index.ts call sites take bare .final and DROP stoppedEarly — a chain that failed a step mid-way is presented to the user as if it completed, in a daily briefing. Silent-wrong = trust erosion.
items.how: Thread stoppedEarly/step-counts through the digest-member runChain (index.ts:174) + the other .final call sites (211, 970) and have the digest/caller append a short '(partial — N of M steps)' note, mirroring handler.ts:1737. Offline unit test: a 2-step chain whose 2nd step returns degraded shows the partial note.

items.title: Infinite-scroll capture: scroll a feed to load more items before reading
items.why: Feeds/listings that load on scroll (not pagination) yield only the initial ~10 items to a single read — a 'what's new on <scrolling feed>' errand under-reports.
items.how: Add a bounded scroll-to-load to the browse path in src/anvil.ts: repeat scrollBy(0, viewport) + wait-for-network-idle up to K times or until item count stops growing, then read. Cap iterations + time. Live e2e against a real infinite-scroll page; assert post-scroll item count > initial.

items.title: Structured extraction across paginated/scrolled results (rows, not a text wall)
items.why: scrape_pages + scroll_feed now GATHER multiple pages, but return raw concatenated text — for "the 5 cheapest" / "20 newest listings" the model must re-parse a big blob, which is lossy + token-heavy. Extracting structured rows (title/price/url) across the gathered pages is the actual competitor-grade listing errand.
items.how: Add a paged/scrolled variant to the extract path (or a fields option on scrape_pages/scroll_feed) that runs the existing per-item extraction over each gathered page and returns a deduped JSON array capped at the requested N. Reuse extract.ts + the multi-page gatherers. Offline unit test with a mock 2-page listing; live e2e asserting N rows across pages.

items.title: Full-page PDF: "save the whole article/thread as a PDF" captures everything, not one print-page
items.why: pdf() renders via anvil /v1/pdf; like screenshot before the fullPage fix, a long thread/article likely gets clipped to default print pagination. A user saving a long page expects the whole thing. Mirror the screenshot-fullpage win.
items.how: Check anvil /v1/pdf options (printBackground, preferCSSPageSize, scale, full-content). Thread a fullPage/complete flag through relay pdf(url,full) + the pdf tool dispatch when the user says whole/entire/full. Live e2e: full PDF byte size materially larger for a long page.

items.title: extract_list should also gather from an infinite-scroll feed (not just pagination)
items.why: extract_list gathers via scrapePaged (pagination links) only. A scroll-loaded feed (no next link) would still extract just the first screen of rows. Pairing it with scrapeScroll closes the gap for feeds like listings/job boards that lazy-load.
items.how: Add a source hint (or auto-detect: if scrapePaged returns pages=1, try scrapeScroll) to extract_list so it can gather from a scrolling feed before the row extraction. Reuse scrapeScroll. Live e2e on a real infinite-scroll listing.

items.title: extract_list can hand back a CSV/spreadsheet file (like compare does)
items.why: compare already offers "as a CSV" -> a spreadsheet file. extract_list returns a JSON array of rows the user often wants to KEEP (20 listings, prices). A CSV export is the natural save for a list, and the rows are already structured.
items.how: When the user says csv/spreadsheet/export, serialize the extract_list rows to CSV (reuse the compare CSV path / a shared rows-to-csv helper) and attach as a doc. Header = fields; one row per item. Unit test the CSV shape; live e2e optional.

items.title: Click-driven "Load more" BUTTON support in the multi-page browse path
items.why: scrapePaged follows <a href> pagers and scrapeScroll handles scroll, but a <button>Load more</button>/<button>Show more</button> that fetches + appends items (very common on listings/job boards/product grids) is neither — the browse tools still get only the first batch.
items.how: In scrapeScroll (or a variant), after each scroll also try clicking a visible button/anchor whose text matches load more|show more|see more (reuse the wants regex, in-page click via evaluate), wait for content to grow, repeat under the same cap+budget. Live e2e on a real load-more listing; assert item count grows past the first batch.

items.title: extract_list dedup should consider all fields, not just the first
items.why: extractListResult dedups by the first field's value only, so two distinct items that share a title (different price/date) collapse to one — a real listing (two tickets same event, different price) loses rows.
items.how: Dedup by a composite key of ALL requested field values (JSON.stringify the normalized row) instead of just field[0]. Keep the all-null skip. Update the dedup unit test.

items.title: anvil: support <select> dropdowns (+ checkbox/radio) in the interactive browse path
items.why: click/type cover text inputs + buttons, but a <select> dropdown, checkbox, or radio (date pickers, filters, sort-by, quantity) cant be set — so a filtered search or a form with a dropdown dead-ends mid-errand. A real chunk of interactive sites need this.
items.how: Add a setValue/select action to anvil (in-page: for a <select> set .value + dispatch change; for checkbox/radio set .checked + click) exposed as a select tool or an option on type. Live e2e on a real page with a dropdown; assert the value took.

items.title: site_search: type a query into a sites own search box + submit, in one tool
items.why: To search WITHIN a site (a store, a docs site, a forum) the agent must browse -> guess the search-box selector -> type -> find+click submit — 4 fragile steps it often flubs. A single site_search(url,query) that finds the search input heuristically (input[type=search], [name*=q], role=searchbox), types, submits, and reads results would make in-site search reliable.
items.how: Add site_search to anvil: navigate, find the search box by common selectors/aria, type the query, submit (Enter or a nearby submit), wait, readCurrent. New agent tool + dispatch. Live e2e against a real site search; assert results returned.

items.title: Extract structured rows from the CURRENT browsed session (post-filter results), not just a URL
items.why: extract_list takes a URL + does its own navigate, so it cant capture the results of an interactive session (after set_field filters + a click). A user who filters a store then wants the rows as a list/CSV cant get structured output from that session — only raw read() text.
items.how: Add an extract mode to read (or a new read_list) that runs extractListResult over readCurrent(session) text with given fields/limit, reusing the session the agent already drove. Offline unit test with a mock backend readCurrent; live e2e: browse->set_field filter->read_list rows.

items.title: wait_for tool: wait until a selector/text appears before reading (slow AJAX/SPA results)
items.why: click/set_field/site_search use fixed sleeps (600-1500ms). A slow SPA filter or lazy result grid can render AFTER that, so read() captures a stale/empty page and the agent answers wrong. A wait-for-selector closes the race.
items.how: Add anvil waitFor(sessionId, selector|text, timeoutMs) that polls in-page (evaluate querySelector / body.innerText.includes) until present or timeout; expose as a wait_for tool the agent calls after an action before read. Live e2e on a page that loads content after a delay.

items.title: Keep a browse session alive across messages so a follow-up continues on the same page
items.why: Every runAgent releases the session at the end (agent.ts:1926), so after "open the flights page and filter to nonstop" a follow-up "now sort by price" starts a brand-new session + re-navigates — the user cant iterate on a live page the way they would with a human assistant. This is the core multi-turn interactive experience the competitor sells.
items.how: Add an opt-in per-chat session carryover: when a turn ends with an OPEN interactive page (browse used, not just scrape), stash {sessionId, url, lastActivity} per chat instead of releasing; a follow-up within an idle TTL (e.g. 3-5 min) reuses it; a reaper releases idle sessions. Guard resource use (one live session per chat, hard idle cap) + never carry a cookie-authed session silently. Needs anvil session-keepalive verified. Unit-test the carryover/reap logic offline; live e2e a 2-message filter-then-sort.

items.title: "open the 2nd result" — act on a numbered item from the last read_list/results
items.why: After read_list gives a numbered list, a user naturally says "open #2" / "more on the third one" — but the rows arent addressable; the agent must re-find the link. Making the last list indexable (like the inline pick buttons for search results) closes the list->act loop.
items.how: Cache the last read_list/extract_list rows per chat (incl. any url/link field); route "open/show the Nth" to browse/scrape that rows link. Reuse the existing result-picker cache pattern (inline-result-picker). Depends partly on session carryover for the smoothest flow but works standalone via the cached link.

items.title: Screenshot the CURRENT carried browse session (not a fresh URL) so the user can see mid-thread state
items.why: With cross-turn continuity, the agent holds a filtered/scrolled live page — but screenshot(url) opens a NEW session + re-navigates, so the user cant SEE the state theyre iterating on (the applied filters, the current results). Seeing it is how a texting user directs the next step ("click the 2nd one").
items.how: Add a screenshotCurrent(sessionId) anvil helper (GET /v1/screenshot?sessionId=... on the OPEN session, no navigate) + route the screenshot tool to it when a browse session is open + no url given. Live e2e: browse+filter, screenshot current, assert bytes reflect the post-filter page.

items.title: Let the user know a page is being held ("still on the flights page — say sort/open/done")
items.why: With continuity ON, a session is silently held for a few minutes. A texting user has no signal that a follow-up will continue vs start fresh, and no easy way to say "drop it". A light touch — a one-line hint after an interactive turn + a "done/close/nevermind" to release — makes the held state legible.
items.how: When a turn returns openSessionId (flag on), append a short hint to the reply (once per held thread). Add a "done"/"close the page"/"nevermind" intent that drops the carried session. Handler-only + gated on the flag; unit-test the hint-once + drop-intent.

items.title: On a click/set_field/type not-found, feed back the page's real candidate elements so the agent self-corrects
items.why: A wrong selector (model guessed '.buy-btn' but it's '#addToCart') returns a bare 'couldn't find it' - the agent then re-guesses blind + often flails or quits mid-errand. The page KNOWS its buttons/inputs; handing back a short list of real candidate selectors + their visible text on a miss turns a dead-end into a one-step self-correct. The single biggest reliability win for interactive tasks.
items.how: Add an anvil describeControls(sessionId, kind) that evaluates the page for visible buttons/links (kind=click) or inputs/selects (kind=field) -> [{selector,text}] (stable selector: id, else name, else nth-of-type path), capped ~12. On a click/set_field/type not-found in dispatch, call it + append candidates to the error push so the model retries with a real one. Live e2e: wrong selector -> candidates returned -> retry hits.

items.title: Agent can report where it currently IS (current url/title) mid-thread
items.why: After a few interactive steps a user may ask 'what page are you on?' / 'what's the link?' - the agent has readCurrent (returns url) but no cheap just-the-location tool, so it does a full read. A tiny where_am_i is a cheap honest orientation.
items.how: Reuse readCurrent but add a lightweight path (or a where tool) returning just {title,url} of the open session; route 'what page/link are you on' to it. Small; depends on an open session.

history.note: Fixed the non-/run chain paths presenting a stopped-early chain as if it completed. digest-runner now takes a STRUCTURED runChain result: a member chain that stopped early (failed/degraded step or unmet if-gate) is shown as "(partial — N of M steps) ..." AND counted as failed (so an all-partial digest hits the honest all-failed notice, not a silent half-answer). index.ts: digest dep (174) returns the structured result; trigger-to-action (211) + "Run again" (970) return null on stoppedEarly (like a degraded run) instead of attaching a partial. The /run path + scheduler already surfaced it. +3 unit tests; live e2e drove the REAL chain-runner+digest-runner (2-step chain, step 2 degraded -> stoppedEarly -> digest returned allFailed). 2184 green. call-tested: partial (real modules, stubbed agent — pure orchestration logic, no anvil needed).

screenshot tool gained fullPage: "screenshot the whole/entire/full page" now captures top-to-bottom, not just the viewport fold. anvil already supported ?fullPage=true (actions.ts page.screenshot({fullPage})); threaded it through relay screenshot(url,fullPage) [+bumped timeout 20s->35s for tall renders], the agent tool schema + dispatch (fullPage:true), the BrowserBackend interface, and /help. +1 unit test. LIVE e2e drove real anvil on a long Wikipedia page: viewport 281KB vs fullPage 1.19MB (4.25x) - whole page captured. 2185 green. call-tested: TRUE (live anvil).

Multi-page browse shipped: new anvil scrapePaged(url,maxPages) reads a listing, finds the next/more/older pager IN the rendered DOM (rel=next, else an anchor whose text/aria-label matches next|more|older|>>|», never previous), follows it reusing ONE session, accumulates labeled page text; capped 1-5 pages (default 3) + 45s budget, loop-guarded (seen-set) + SSRF-checked on each next URL. New agent tool scrape_pages (url,maxPages) + dispatch (clamps 1-5, reports pages read so the model doesn't overclaim) + BrowserBackend.scrapePaged + SYSTEM_PROMPT + /help. scrape() unchanged. +4 unit tests. LIVE e2e drove real anvil on Hacker News: followed More -> 3 distinct pages (news, ?p=2, ?p=3), 12.3K chars vs 4.2K single-page (2.95x). 2188 green. call-tested: TRUE (live anvil, real pagination).

Infinite-scroll capture shipped: new anvil scrapeScroll(url,maxScrolls) navigates, dismisses consent, scrolls to the bottom repeatedly (900ms settle per step) until the page stops growing / cap / 45s budget, then reads the fully-expanded text. Capped 1-10 scrolls (default 5). New agent tool scroll_feed (url,maxScrolls) + dispatch (clamps, reports scrolls done so the model doesn't overclaim) + BrowserBackend.scrapeScroll + SYSTEM_PROMPT + /help. +2 unit tests. LIVE e2e on quotes.toscrape.com/scroll (real infinite-scroll): plain scrape 1492 chars (~first 10) vs scrolled 6x -> 12181 chars (8.16x, all items loaded). 2190 green. call-tested: TRUE (live anvil). This completes the anvil browse-depth backlog (pagination + full-page shot + scroll all done).

Structured list extraction across pages shipped. New extractListResult(llm,text,fields,limit) asks the LLM for a JSON ARRAY of row-objects, normalized to the requested fields, deduped by the first field, all-null rows dropped, capped 1-50. New extract_list tool (url,fields,limit,maxPages) gathers across pagination via scrapePaged (default 2 pages) then extracts rows — the real "5 cheapest / 20 newest with price+link" errand, returning clean rows not a text wall. +6 unit tests. ALSO fixed a real pagination-detector bug found in live e2e: NEXT_PAGE_SCRIPT required an EXACT label match so "Next →"/"Next »" (arrow-suffixed, the common case) was NOT followed — now strips trailing/leading arrow glyphs before matching (also strengthens the shipped scrape_pages). LIVE e2e: quotes.toscrape.com 2 pages gathered -> real Gemini extracted 8 {author,quote} rows across pages. 2196 green. call-tested: TRUE.

extract_list now gathers from an infinite-scroll feed, not just pagination: when scrapePaged finds no next link (pages===1) it auto-falls back to scrapeScroll(5) to expand the feed before row extraction. Closes the gap for scroll-loaded listings/job boards. Tool description + dispatch note ("from scrolling (Nx)") updated. +2 unit tests (fallback fires on pages===1; NOT when multi-page gathered). LIVE e2e: quotes.toscrape.com/scroll (no pager) -> pagination saw 1 page -> scroll 5x (10K chars) -> Gemini extracted 10 distinct {author,quote} rows. 2198 green. call-tested: TRUE.

NOT A GAP (verified, not built). Assumed pdf() clipped a long page like screenshot did, but anvil pdf() uses page.pdf({format}) which paginates the ENTIRE page across paper pages by default. Live probe: example.com -> 1 page/22KB, long Wikipedia -> 7 pages/676KB, whole content captured. No fix needed; avoided shipping filler. Marked not-needed.

extract_list can now hand back its rows as a downloadable CSV (extract-list-csv): when the user says csv/spreadsheet/export, the extracted rows are serialized via the shared rowsToCsv (reused from compare) + attached as list.csv instead of pasted as JSON. Header=fields, one row per item. Tool description + /help updated. +2 unit tests (CSV attached on request; NOT attached otherwise). 2200 green. call-tested: false (offline unit; pure serialization of already-live-verified extraction).

scrapeScroll now handles a click-driven Load more/Show more BUTTON, not just pure scroll: when a scroll doesnt grow the page it tries clicking a visible, enabled button/anchor whose text matches load more|show more|see more|more results (in-page click via evaluate), waits, re-measures, and only stops if THAT also adds nothing. A pure-scroll feed is unchanged (stops immediately when scroll stops growing). scroll_feed + extract_list (which falls back to scrapeScroll) both inherit it. Tool description + doc updated. LIVE e2e: pure-scroll regression intact (quotes/scroll 5 scrolls, 10K chars); load-more click verified on an injected real-http listing (Load more click grew list 1 -> 11 items). 2200 green. call-tested: TRUE. Logic in anvil internals (module-level fetch), so live e2e is the proof; scroll_feed tool routing covered by dispatch unit tests.

extract_list now dedups by ALL requested fields (composite delimiter-joined key), not just the first — two genuinely-different items sharing a title (two tickets same event different price, two listings same title different date) BOTH survive; only a row identical across every field collapses. Also fixed a latent bug found while editing: the prior join used a stray  (SOH) byte as delimiter, now a clean " | ". +2 unit tests (share-title-keep-both; exact-dup-collapse). 2201 green. call-tested: false (pure logic).

site_search shipped: navigate to a site, find its search box heuristically (type=search, name/id/aria/placeholder containing search|q, role=searchbox, scored), set value via the native setter + fire input/change (React-safe), submit (form.requestSubmit else a submit/search button else Enter keydown), wait, read results. New anvil siteSearch(url,query) + agent tool + dispatch (honest found:false -> "landing page, try web_search site:") + BrowserBackend + SYSTEM_PROMPT + /help. Replaces the fragile browse->guess-selector->type->find-submit->click dance for in-site search. +3 dispatch tests. LIVE e2e: Wikipedia search "photosynthesis" -> found:true, landed on the Photosynthesis article (88K chars, mentions query); MDN -> found:false (modal-trigger search, not inline) and HONESTLY reported it (no false success). 2204 green. call-tested: TRUE.

set_field shipped: drives the form controls click/type couldnt — a <select> dropdown (match option by value OR visible text, case-insensitive substring ok), checkbox/radio (on/off, clicks to toggle so frameworks see it), or any inputs value (React-safe native setter + input/change). New anvil setField(sessionId,selector,value) + agent tool set_field + dispatch (requires prior browse; honest not-found/no-option; safety-guarded so a confirm/delete control is REFUSED) + BrowserBackend + SYSTEM_PROMPT + /help note. +3 dispatch tests (dropdown set; no-browse errors; delete-box refused). LIVE e2e on an injected real page: select set by visible text (value->p), checkbox toggled on, missing selector -> not-found. 2207 green. call-tested: TRUE. Completes the interactive form path (filters/sort/quantity/agree now settable, still read-only-safe).

wait_for shipped: waits until a CSS selector OR a text phrase appears on the current session page (polls ~400ms up to a 1-30s clamp, default 8s) before reading — closes the read-too-early race after click/set_field/site_search on slow SPA/AJAX pages where the fixed sleeps could read a stale/empty page. Auto-detects selector-vs-text (tries querySelector, falls back to body text includes). New anvil waitFor(sessionId,target,timeoutMs) + agent tool wait_for + dispatch (needs prior browse; honest timeout message -> read anyway but warn) + BrowserBackend + SYSTEM_PROMPT. +2 dispatch tests. LIVE e2e: delayed content appended after 1.5s -> selector detected at 1.65s, text phrase found, #never-appears timed out false at ~2s. 2209 green. call-tested: TRUE.

read_list shipped: extracts structured rows from the CURRENT browsed session (post-filter/sort/search results), not a fresh URL — the finish to the interactive form arc. Reuses readCurrent(session) + extractListResult (dedup, cap) + the CSV path (add a spreadsheet ask -> list.csv). New agent tool read_list(fields,limit) + dispatch (needs prior browse; honest nothing-matched hint to try wait_for). No new backend method (reuses readCurrent). +3 dispatch tests (rows from current session; CSV on request; no-browse errors). LIVE e2e: browse quotes.toscrape -> readCurrent -> real Gemini extracted 10 rows (8 distinct authors) from the session. 2212 green. call-tested: TRUE. Completes browse->set_field->wait_for->read_list: filter a site + get structured rows/CSV back.

open-nth-result shipped: after a numbered list, a user can now TEXT "open the 2nd" / "#3" / "number 4" / "the last one" (not just tap the 1/2/3 button) and get that item + its link resent from the cached pickLists — no agent re-run. New parsePickIndex parser (digits, ordinals, number-words, #N, verb-gated + whole-message so a real task like "3 day forecast"/"open example.com" isnt hijacked; last->final item). Wired in handler after the more/link drilldown block, reusing the pick-tap resend logic + pickLists cache. Out-of-range -> honest count. +5 tests (10 parser + handler text-pick + out-of-range). /help updated. 2217 green. call-tested: n/a (pure logic + handler, no anvil path).

Multi-turn browse continuity shipped (opt-in RELAY_BROWSE_CONTINUITY, default OFF). runAgent gained resumeSessionId (seed this run from a carried session) + keepSessionOpen (dont release at end; hand back openSessionId). New BrowseSessionStore (src/lib/browse-session.ts): one OPEN session per chat, lazy idle-reaped (BROWSE_IDLE_MS default 3min, no timers), releases on replace/idle/drop. Handler carries openSessionId between turns when the flag+releaser are wired: turn 2 resumes turn 1s page so "now sort by price" continues where it left off; a turn that stops browsing drops+releases; /reset releases. index wires releaseBrowseSession only when flag on. .env.example documented. Default OFF = byte-identical single-turn behavior (2217 baseline unchanged). +15 tests (8 store + 4 agent resume/keep + 3 handler carry). LIVE e2e on real anvil: set window marker + url on a session turn 1, resumed same session turn 2 -> marker+url survived (state persists across turns). 2232 green. call-tested: TRUE.

screenshot can now capture the CURRENT open browse session instead of only re-navigating a fresh URL: OMIT the url + a session is open -> new anvil screenshotCurrent(sessionId,fullPage) shoots the live page (no navigate/release), so with continuity on the user SEES the filtered/scrolled state theyre iterating on. New anvil helper + BrowserBackend.screenshotCurrent + dispatch routing (no-url + open session -> current; else the url path) + tool schema (url now optional) + SYSTEM_PROMPT. +2 dispatch tests. LIVE e2e: navigate + mutate the live page (simulated filter) + screenshotCurrent -> 10.6KB capture of the mutated page, no re-nav. 2234 green. call-tested: TRUE.

Made held-browse-session state legible (session-status-surface, continuity flag on): the FIRST time a page is kept open for a thread, the reply appends a one-time hint ("kept that page open — say sort/filter to keep going, or done to close"); a "done"/"close the page"/"nevermind" message releases the carried tab + confirms. New isCloseSessionRequest parser (whole-message + anchored so "close my rings"/"are you done?" arent intercepted). Hint fires once per hold (browseHinted set, cleared on drop/reset/close). All handler+flag-gated; default OFF unchanged. +3 tests (parser match/reject, hint-once + done-closes). 2237 green. call-tested: n/a (handler logic, no anvil path).

probes.note: Seeded from the inline 3-lens gap analysis run at the end of the product-loop session (subagent cap 200/200 blocked the parallel AUDIT agents, so lenses were run inline over schedule-runner/alert-runner/chain-runner/agent/handler/anvil). Keyless-tool surface confirmed exhausted. Real remaining depth gaps: browse reads ONE page only (no pagination/scroll/crawl — grep=0), screenshot is viewport-only (anvil.ts:463), and non-/run chain paths drop stoppedEarly (partial presented as complete). Owner picked the anvil-depth direction; these 4 are the starting backlog. In-place schedule EDIT (alerts retune but reminders can't) was also found — parked for a reliability pass, not this browse-depth loop.

Depth trio complete (pagination, full-page screenshot, infinite-scroll — all live-verified). Next depth tier surfaced while building: (1) the multi-page tools return RAW concatenated page text; a listing errand ("5 cheapest", "20 newest") would be far stronger if the agent EXTRACTED structured rows across the gathered pages (title/price/link) instead of the model re-parsing a wall of text — pairs scrape_pages/scroll_feed with the existing extract path. (2) full-page PDF: pdf() exists but, like screenshot was, likely renders one viewport/print-page; "save the whole thread/article as PDF" wants the full scroll. Seeded both. Owner-gated confirm-to-act multi-step chains + in-place schedule edit still parked.
Live e2e caught the arrow-label pagination miss (quotes.toscrape uses "Next →"); fixed in NEXT_PAGE_SCRIPT. Confirms the value of driving REAL sites, not just mock pages.

Browse-depth surface now thorough: pagination (link, arrow-suffixed), infinite-scroll, full-page screenshot, cross-page structured extraction (extract_list), CSV export. pdf-fullpage verified NON-issue (page.pdf paginates whole page already). Remaining depth gap surfaced: a click-driven <button>Load more</button> that fetches+appends items is NEITHER a link pager (NEXT_PAGE matches load-more only as <a href>) NOR scroll — a common listing pattern still yields page one. Seeded load-more-button. Also: extract_list dedups by FIRST field only, so two genuinely different items sharing a title collapse — minor, seeded as a refinement.

Browse-DEPTH (reading many results) is now complete: pagination + infinite-scroll + load-more button gathering, cross-page structured extract_list, CSV export, all-field dedup. Next frontier is browse-BREADTH / interactive depth (acting on a page), which is thinner: click/type are single-selector only (no multi-field form fill in one step), no <select>/dropdown/checkbox support in anvil, and no site-search convenience (user must browse->find selector->type->click manually). These are the errands that turn Relay from a READER into a DOER (still read-only-safe: no submit/pay, the dangerous-action guard stays). Seeded fill_form + site_search.

Interactive form path now complete: browse + click + type + set_field (select/checkbox/radio) + site_search + read, all safety-guarded. Two gaps surfaced: (1) after a filtered/sorted interactive session the agent can only read() raw text — extract_list runs on a fresh URL, so structured rows from the CURRENT session (post-filter results) arent directly extractable. (2) No wait-for-selector/settle tool: click/set_field use fixed sleeps, so a slow AJAX result (SPA filter, lazy grid) may be read before it renders -> stale/empty read. Seeded both.

Interactive arc COMPLETE + reliable: browse + site_search + type + set_field (dropdown/checkbox/radio) + wait_for + read + read_list (structured rows/CSV from the current session), all safety-guarded + live-verified. Whole browse roadmap (depth: pagination/scroll/load-more/extract/CSV; breadth: search/fill/select/wait/structured-read) is thorough. Next frontier surfaced: the browse SESSION is released at the end of every runAgent (agent.ts:1926), so a follow-up message ("now sort by price", "open the 2nd result") re-navigates from scratch instead of continuing on the open page — a real multi-turn-interaction gap, but L (cross-message session lifecycle + idle-timeout + resource/security). Seeded it + a smaller list-index follow-up.

Multi-turn browse continuity DONE (opt-in) — the interactive arc is now end-to-end: open a page, filter/sort/search/fill, wait, read structured rows/CSV, AND keep iterating across messages on the same live page. Whole browse roadmap (depth + breadth + continuity) complete. Next frontier: (1) confirm-to-act multi-step chains stay OWNER-GATED (a committing sequence needs sign-off). (2) With continuity live, the natural add is letting the user SEE the live page mid-thread (a screenshot of the current carried session) so they can direct the next step — currently screenshot re-navigates a fresh URL. Seeded that + a session-status surface.

Browse arc complete (depth+breadth+continuity+visibility+status), all opt-in/guarded/live-verified. Cookie-jar authed-site access is ENV-config only (RELAY_COOKIES file) + owner-gated by design (a user can't text their session cookies safely) - leave as-is. Real fresh gap: interactive error recovery. A wrong click/set_field selector returns a bare 'couldn't find #x' - the agent doesn't get the page's ACTUAL clickable/settable elements, so it guesses again + flails or gives up. Feeding back nearby candidate selectors on a not-found turns a dead-end into a self-correct. Seeded that + a smaller current-url surface.
